Settings.note: Leave a field empty until the business decision is made: nothing is charged or promised for empty fields. Every change is recorded in the audit log, and bookings keep the settings they were made with.
Settings.commission: Platform commission (% of the stay price)
Settings.guestFee: Guest service fee (% added on top)
Settings.deposit: Monthly rental deposit (% of one month)
Settings.moneyHint: The guest pays the stay price plus the service fee. The owner is owed the stay price minus the commission.
Settings.cancellationHint: Shown to guests before they book and saved with each booking. Write it in each language.
Settings.upfrontMonths: Months paid when booking (empty = all months chosen)
Settings.monthlyHint: Guests choose how many months to rent. Leave empty and they pay for all of them when booking; set a number to take only those months upfront. Lodges and single rooms are always paid by the night.
Settings.referralHint: A reward is created only after the invited friend's first finished stay, and staff approve each one. Leave empty for no reward.
